hypothesis_text: When the tracked cohort's 24h net flow in BTC flips from net-short to net-long, BTC continues higher over the following day, by enough to clear 60s-delayed taker execution.

kill_criteria.description: Kill if the strategy does not make money after frictions.
Kill if profit factor is below 1.2 — too thin to survive worse slippage.
Kill if fewer than 10 trades: nothing to conclude from.
Kill if peak-to-trough drawdown exceeds 25% of the stated capital base.

look_ahead_flags: Cohort membership is whatever the capture daemon tracks today; wallets added to tracking after the window began contribute flow to the earlier part of the window.
notes.mechanism_text: Cohort net flow is an aggregate of informed-trader positioning; a sign flip is a change in that group's directional stance, which should precede price if their information is real and not already priced.
